title: Antara Bumoe Ngon Langét .
intro: Saboh jiwa nyang misterius jipreh gata lam halaman-halaman suci seujarah ilahi, jiba tanda-tanda dan keuajaiban nyang mantong meu-gema lam masa-masa. Bak gata ta ikot jeujak petunjuk, gata akan tajak rot saboh kisah nyang jitanda ngon mukjizat — nibak awai nyang ajaeb sampoe u ateuh langet. Jeut neuidentifikasi hamba nyang meubarakah nyoe sigohlom petunjuk akhe?
clues: Lon geukirém sibagoe utusan keu Bani Israil deungon haba rahmat dan trang.
Lahé ulôn nakeuh saboh tanda ajaéb — ulôn teuka u dônja njoë hana ayah, deungon peurintah Nyang Mahakuasa.
Lon peugah haba watee mantong aneuk miet, lon peutheun keuhormatan mak lon ateuh tuduhan umat gobnyan.
Deungon izin Allah, ulôn peugot cicém nibak tanoh kliet dan ulôn peu-ék udép lam cicém-cicém nyan — cicém-cicém nyan jiplueng dikeue mata ureuëng-ureuëng nyang kalon.

Lon peupuleh ureueng-ureueng nyang lahe buta, lon peupuléh ureueng-ureueng kusta, dan bahkan lon peubeudoh ureueng mate — bahpih meunan, tiep-tiep mukjizat na kheueh deungon izin Allah, kon deungon izin lon keudroe.
Watèë musôh-musoh lôn meu-reuncana untôk peubinasa ulôn, Allah neu-angkèë ulôn u langèt dan neu-djandji keulai ulôn sigohlom uroë kiamat.

trial.label: Momen Nyang Peunentu
options: Ulôn ka geupeuék u langèt .
Ulôn teurhom lam apui hu nyang hu .
Lon meuhadap ngon teuntra Firaun nyang peukasa .
Lon jiteumeung le paus rayeuk
Ulôn peugét kapai di ateueh gunong nyan .

location.label: Tanda Suci Geupeubuet .
options: Lon peugot cicem dari tanoh kliet
Tungkat Ulôn peujeuet keu uleue .
Lon belah buleun jeut keu dua .
Lon yue angen ngon jin .
Ulôn peuteubiet saboh unta inong nibak gunong batée .
location.answer: Lon peugot cicem dari tanoh kliet

outcome.label: Peue Jeuet Keu Ulôn .
options: Dipeuék u langét; meujanji keu geuwoe .
Jeuet keu peunguasa rayeuk saboh keurajeuën .
Neupimpén umat Lôn peuteubiet nibak teumpat nyang teuböih .
Dibri keukayaan donya nyang hana meutandingan .
Teungoh meusaboh lom ngon keuluarga lon lheuh trep meupisah .
outcome.answer: Dipeuék u langét; meujanji keu geuwoe .

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verse: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel. (43:59)
